Container.Name: hindi-lessons
Container.Overview: A self-hosted six-month Delhi Hindi course: the full five-book reader, a typed-answer practice engine with forgiving grading, spaced repetition, and a momentum tracker with streaks, a study heatmap and milestones. Multi-user with local accounts. All data lives in a single SQLite file in the mapped /data folder. Optionally uses your own self-hosted LLM (any OpenAI-compatible endpoint) as a second-opinion grader for sentence translations.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite database and all user progress. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Your timezone — study days and streaks are counted against it.

Config.Name: Open signup
Config.Description: true = anyone reaching the page can create an account. Set false once you and your partner have signed up.

Config.Name: Require invite code
Config.Description: true = new accounts need a code you generate as admin. The first account is always allowed.

Config.Name: AI base URL
Config.Description: Optional. Your self-hosted OpenAI-compatible endpoint, including /v1 — e.g. http://192.168.1.50:11434/v1 for Ollama. Leave blank to grade with rules only.

Config.Name: AI model
Config.Description: Optional. Model name, e.g. qwen2.5:7b-instruct. Only used with AI base URL.

Config.Name: AI API key
Config.Description: Optional. Only if your local endpoint requires one.
